title: The silence of the forest
text: The night in the forest was quiet, only owls hooting in the distance. Everyone slept under the stars wrapped in the scent of pine.

title: Wolf howls
text: Wolves howled nearby all night. The fire burned until morning and nobody dared close their eyes for long.

title: Mushrooms
text: After rain mushrooms sprang up in the forest. The scavengers gathered full baskets and the camp had an abundant soup.

title: Bear tracks
text: Tracks of a large bear, fresh and deep, were found near the camp. Everyone kept weapons at hand.

title: Footsteps in the dark
text: Something walked around the camp in the dark snapping twigs. By morning there were no tracks.

title: Deer
text: A herd of deer passed the camp in the morning light. The marksmen held their breath but nobody shot.

title: Woodcutters
text: Woodcutters from a nearby village felled trees close to the camp. The crew watched from hiding until they left.

title: The falling branch
text: A branch fell and crushed one of the tents. Fortunately nobody was in it.

title: Rain
text: It poured all night and the branch roof leaked. By morning everyone was soaked to the skin.

title: The stream
text: A stream near the camp offered fresh water and a handful of fish. Everyone washed and ate.

title: Beastmen
text: Horned silhouettes flickered among the trees but nobody felt like checking. The sentries stayed awake till dawn.

title: The lost hunter
text: A hunter from a nearby village got lost in the forest and stumbled onto the camp. The crew led him to the trail for a few coins.

title: Berries
text: Wild berries ripened in a clearing. Everyone gathered handfuls and had purple hands till evening.

title: Smoke on the horizon
text: Far above the forest a column of smoke rose. Someone was burning a village or an army's campfire, nobody knew.

title: The boar
text: A boar leapt from the thicket and ran through the camp. Everyone scattered and then laughed at their own fear.

title: Damp leaf litter
text: The litter was so wet the fire barely burned. Everyone froze and the food tasted of smoke.

title: The wayside cross
text: An old wooden cross with carved names stood by the forest path. The crew paused in silence and moved on.

title: Thick fog
text: Fog filled the forest to the brim and nobody could see further than arm's length. Orientation became difficult.

title: The lost purse
text: A purse with a few coins lay under a tree. Someone lost it, someone's looking for it and the coins are already yours.

title: The madman in the forest
text: A feral man in rags came out of the thicket and screamed something unintelligible. Then he ran and you didn't sleep till morning.

title: The wayside seller
text: A wandering seller of herbs and roots came upon you in the forest. The crew bought a few remedies and traded rumours.

title: Strigoi
text: By the fire tales were told of strigoi that feed on travellers' blood. Everyone began guarding their necks.

title: Wind in the canopy
text: The wind roared in the treetops and it was hard to hear anything else. The sentries were on edge.

title: The lost dog
text: A hunting dog wandered into camp with a snapped leash. Fed and petted, it stayed with the crew.

title: The wrecked trail
text: A fallen tree blocked the trail you were to take. It had to be bypassed or cut.

title: Creaking in the night
text: In the night the trees creaked as under a weight. Some said it was the wind, others that corpses hang from them.

title: Ants
text: Ants attacked the supplies and carried them about the whole camp. Everyone shook out blankets and cursed.

title: The distant bell
text: From afar came the sound of a bell from an unknown chapel. The crew couldn't tell whether it was a good sign or bad.

title: The wandering bear
text: A bear walked through the camp looking for food. If someone provokes it there will be wounded.
okText: The bodyguard stood in the bear's path looking it in the eye and the animal left with dignity, leaving the remains of a boar.

title: The toppled tree
text: A tree fell on the camp and pinned the supply wagon. Without leverage it can't be lifted.
okText: The bodyguard lifted the trunk with his own hands and pulled out the wagon. The supplies survived and people watched in admiration.

title: The forest robber
text: A robber crept into the camp trying to steal a chest of loot. Nobody has noticed him yet.
okText: The shadow kept watch in the gloom, seized the robber by the throat and made him sing where he'd hidden his own stash. The loot grew.

title: The tracking scout
text: A scout for the count's army sniffs around near the camp. If he returns with a report the crew will be in trouble.
okText: The shadow caught him noiselessly, knocked him out and left him tied far from the camp, taking his map.

title: The spy raven
text: A huge raven circles over the camp and shrieks as if calling others. Someone might hear it.
okText: The marksman brought the bird down with one shot and in the morning a ring with a valuable mark was taken from its leg. By dinner it was roasted.

title: The hunt
text: Deer passed the camp but moved on. The marksman could stop them but must be very quick.
okText: The marksman shot a stag with one arrow and two more with precise follow-ups. The crew had meat for a whole week.

title: The forest brothers
text: A band of forest brothers appears at the camp asking who's in charge. They behave menacingly.
okText: The provocateur told them such a funny story about a reeve that everyone laughed and invited them to the fire. Their leader gave a gift.

title: The travelling juggler
text: A travelling juggler stopped at the camp and wants to perform for food. If someone else came it might be dangerous.
okText: The provocateur joined the act and afterwards both told of routes they knew. The juggler left a useful map and a handful of coins.

title: The wounded in the forest
text: A wounded man lies by the path, clearly suffering. If nobody helps he'll die.
okText: The scavenger dressed the wounds, gave herbal tea and by morning the man asked to join the crew. He had a few coins in his pocket.

title: Poisonous mushrooms
text: Among the gathered mushrooms are a few poisonous ones. If nobody recognises them dinner will end in disaster.
okText: The scavenger recognised the poisonous mushrooms in a minute, threw them out and made a wonderful soup from the rest. Everyone ate their fill.

title: The stranded wagon
text: A wagon with barrels is stuck in a muddy forest road. The driver begs for help and the barrels look full.
okText: The carter led the horses expertly, pulled the wagon out of the mud and got a barrel of wine and a few coins from the owner in thanks.

title: The forest trail
text: The trail through the forest is blocked by soldiers and your supplies must reach the hideout. Another route is needed.
okText: The carter knew an old woodcutters' trail and led the supplies through without trouble. On the way he sold a few trinkets to people he met.

title: Felled trees
text: The count's soldiers are clearing the forest to ease their passage. The crew will lose its hideout if nobody stops them.
okText: The arsonist set the tool stores and scaffolds ablaze in several places. The soldiers were delayed for weeks and the crew found rich loot.

title: The hunters' trap
text: Bounty hunters set snares on forest paths. One of yours might step into one.
okText: The arsonist located the snares and disarmed them so that the hunters fell into them on their return. Their loot went to the crew.

title: The lost road
text: The crew lost the trail and has circled among trees for an hour. The road must be found before night falls.
okText: The scout read animal tracks, moss on trees and the position of the stars and in half an hour led everyone to the trail. On the way he found a cache.

title: Strange tracks
text: In the morning unknown boot prints appeared around the camp. Someone is touring us and we haven't seen him.
okText: The scout followed the trail to the stranger's hideout, took his map and left a false trail. The crew gained an advantage.

title: The fur trader
text: A wandering fur trader asks for help selling his goods because his customers fled. The pelts look of good quality.
okText: The fence found a buyer, negotiated the price and shared the profit with the trader. Everyone came out well.

title: Treasure maps
text: A wanderer offers a treasure map for a few coins. Either truth or a swindle.
okText: The fence examined the map, recognised several genuine landmarks and set out with men. The treasure was modest but real.

title: The forest witch
text: An old woman from a hut in the forest says your man is cursed. She'll cast a spell if she isn't paid.
okText: The healer talked with the old woman, offered an exchange of herbs and a shared trick, and she lifted the curse and gave a stock of medicines.

title: The poisoned stream
text: The stream by the camp suddenly changed colour and stinks. It can't be drunk and there's no other water.
okText: The healer found the cause, pointed to a spring nearby and cleansed the water with herbs. Everyone drank and caught a few fish too.

title: Meeting a knight
text: A knight errant challenged your men to a duel for the right to pass through the forest. Refusing is an insult.
okText: The duellist accepted and after a spectacular duel let the knight consider himself the winner. The knight handed over a purse in thanks.

title: The bandit challenge
text: A band of robbers blocks the path demanding a toll. If nobody persuades them there'll be bloodshed.
okText: The duellist challenged the leader to a duel, beat him in three moves and demanded the robbers hand over what they'd collected. They left, leaving their pouches.

title: The wooden doll
text: A wooden doll with a strange carved symbol lies under a tree. Everyone whispers around it.

title: The doll's owner
text: A little girl appears in camp and asks about the doll, saying it belongs to her sister who vanished in the forest.

title: The map on bark
text: Someone carved a map with a cross on an old tree trunk. The marks are fresh.

title: The treasure beneath the cross
text: The crew dug up a box at the spot marked with the cross. Inside were coins and a letter with a warning.

title: The hermit
text: A hermit in rags came out of the forest asking for water. He says he has something to pass on but not to whom.

title: The hermit's message
text: The hermit returned and told of a hidden crossing through the marshes. For the information he demands food and promises a favour.

title: The howl in the night
text: In the night an unusual howl rose that wasn't wolves'. All animals fell silent.

title: What howled
text: In the morning tracks of a great beast were found beside an abandoned bag of coins. Whether animal or mutant, nobody knows.

title: The curious stone
text: A mossy stone covered in writing in an unknown tongue was found in the forest. The older trees around it seem to avoid it.

title: The stone glows
text: At night the stone began to glow with a greenish light. The crew must decide whether to destroy it or investigate.

title: A shrine of Taal
text: Deep in the forest stands a shrine to Taal with antlers and a jug of honey. The crew left an offering and felt calmer.

title: The charcoal burner's kiln
text: A charcoal burner at his kiln offered the crew hot food and told of the roads. He was lonely and glad of company.

title: The beastmen's herdstone
text: A stone covered in blood and trophies stands among the trees. Beastmen marked their territory and the crew stands too close.

title: Goblin drums
text: Goblin drums are heard in the distance. If they're coming this way nobody wants to be close but nobody knows where to flee.

title: The strayed stag
text: A wounded stag stumbled into camp and fell at your feet. The meat will last several days.

title: Moss
text: The crew camped in thick moss. It was warm, soft and quiet, as if the forest wanted to embrace them.

title: The army camp
text: The emperor's army camped in the nearby valley. The crew watched their fires and quietly withdrew.

title: Ravens
text: Ravens settled in the trees around the camp and watched in silence. When someone threw a stone they took off together.

title: The wasp nest
text: Wasps built a nest right above the camp. Two followers were stung and cursed all day.

title: A stream of fish
text: A stream full of trout ran past the camp. The crew feasted and set aside stores for the road.

title: The old cache
text: A hidden cache of crates was found in a rotting trunk. The contents were rotten but three coins lay at the bottom.

title: The creeper
text: Vines wound round a tent and it couldn't be opened. Everyone sweated cutting them with knives.

title: Birdsong
text: Birds sang from dawn so beautifully that even the heaviest sleep gave way. The morning was pleasant.

title: Clamour from the road
text: From the direction of the road came noise, neighing and shouts. A convoy passed and the crew watched from the bushes.

title: The forked path
text: The crew reached a fork in the roads, each seeming equally dangerous. The discussion took half the night.

title: A fire in the distance
text: Far in the forest a fire burned. Someone was announcing their presence or something was aflame. The crew stayed hidden.

title: Bats
text: In the morning bats returned to a cave in the rock above the camp. A cloud of wings blotted the sky.

title: The rotten stump
text: A split rotten trunk turned out full of grubs and birds flocked to feast. One of the marksmen bagged a few.

title: Locusts
text: A cloud of insects flew over the forest. Everyone covered their faces and waited for it to pass.

title: Roe deer
text: A pair of roe deer grazed in a clearing. The crew watched in silence and then let them go.

title: The woodcutters' road
text: A narrow woodcutters' road led through the forest and was well kept. The crew used it to get to their goal quickly.

title: Fog and lights
text: In the fog strange lights flickered, dancing above the ground. The crew didn't follow them but didn't sleep till morning.

title: The vanishing trail
text: The crew followed an animal track but the marks vanished in the middle of a clearing. Nobody could explain why.

title: The old woodcutter
text: An old woodcutter with an axe passed through the camp and wished a good night. He didn't ask who you were. He understood.

title: Falling leaves
text: Autumn leaves fell so thick everything was covered in gold. The crew lit a fire and listened to the silence.

title: Odd mushrooms
text: Mushrooms shaped like human hands sprouted in a clearing. The scavenger refused to gather them and told everyone not to touch.

title: Fog over the water
text: White fog hung above the lake and a boat without a rower loomed in it. Everyone moved away from the shore.

title: The path to the hideout
text: The crew found a shorter route to the hideout skirting the hills. They saved much time and strength.

title: The furious boar
text: A furious boar charged into the camp and attacks anything that moves. If no one stops it there'll be slaughter.
okText: The bodyguard grabbed the boar by the tusks, pinned it to the ground and ended its life. The crew had meat for two weeks.

title: Armed pursuit
text: A band of armed men searches the forest and closes on your camp. The crew must decide whether to flee or fight.
okText: The bodyguard blocked the narrow pass and the opponents, seeing his gaze, reconsidered and withdrew. They left a pouch.

title: A traitor in the crew
text: Someone in the crew secretly sells information about your hideout. The shadow noticed night movements.
okText: The shadow followed the traitor for three nights, caught him red-handed and took the enemy's payment from him. The traitor was thrown out.

title: Night messages
text: In the middle of the night someone left a note by the chief's tent. It reads: "I know where you are."
okText: The shadow traced the author, who turned out to be an old companion wanting to return. He took down a message for him and quietly took him back.

title: Smoke in the distance
text: A great column of smoke rises from the valley and horses neigh uneasily. Someone must check what's happening.
okText: The marksman climbed a high tree, saw a burning hunters' camp and from a distance took down three sentries. They found loot in the ruins.

title: The bandit falconer
text: A bandit with a falcon perches in the treetops watching travellers. If he spots the crew he'll call others.
okText: The marksman took out the falconer with one shot and the falcon flew away. A few coins and a useful map were found on the robber.

title: The hunters' camp
text: Bounty hunters camped nearby and follow every move. If they notice something they'll report to the count.
okText: The provocateur visited their camp as a pedlar, drank a few tankards with them and told of bandits in another part of the forest. The hunters moved on.

title: Drunken woodcutters
text: A group of drunk woodcutters stopped nearby and sing loudly. They'll draw the watch if nobody quiets them.
okText: The provocateur joined the drunks, led them elsewhere and on the way exchanged a few barrels for supplies. The crew gained a few favours.

title: Mouldy stores
text: Damp ruined some of the stores and everything is covered in mould. If nobody salvages it the crew will go hungry.
okText: The scavenger dried the surviving stores over the fire, sorted and seasoned them with herbs. Part of the supplies could be saved.

title: Wounded soldiers
text: Several wounded soldiers from a fled company lie in the forest. They beg help and promise a reward.
okText: The scavenger dressed all of them and left supplies for the road. The soldiers gave the crew part of their pay and advised how to avoid patrols.

title: The night convoy
text: A convoy of wagons passes along a forest road guarded by a few men. If someone stops it there will be good loot.
okText: The carter blocked the road with a felled tree and arranged an ambush. The crew took the most valuable wagons without bloodshed.

title: The secret path
text: The crew must move goods across the county border but the main roads are guarded. They seek a secret path.
okText: The carter knew an old smugglers' trail and led the wagons through without trouble. The sale on the other side brought a tidy profit.

title: The armoury on the hill
text: A small tower on the hill holds a stock of weapons. Its garrison sleeps and the stores would come in handy.
okText: The arsonist started a fire in the stable and in the confusion the crew emptied the store. The weapons were sold for good money.

title: The enemy's camp
text: A rival crew camped nearby and threatens your interests. It must be driven out.
okText: The arsonist burned their supplies and tents in the night. The rivals fled in panic, leaving loot behind.

title: The marsh
text: The trail leads through a marsh and the routes are unknown. The risk of drowning is real.
okText: The scout recognised firm ground by the vegetation and built a path from branches. Everyone passed unscathed and beyond the marsh they found an abandoned hut.

title: Strange prints
text: Tracks of a creature that fits no known species are visible on the path. The crew is uneasy.
okText: The scout examined the tracks and they turned out to be those of ordinary animals altered by rain. He also found a forgotten bandit hideout.

title: The escapee
text: A man without boots flees the army and offers everything he has for shelter. He carries a purse and documents.
okText: The fence checked the documents, hid the fugitive and sold his secrets to several interested parties. The crew got a good price.

title: Stolen satchels
text: A traveller offers several satchels holding valuable documents for sale. Origin unknown.
okText: The fence recognised the documents, knew whom to sell them to and got a good price. Everybody profited.

title: Festering wounds
text: Several followers have wounds that began to fester. If nobody acts they'll start fevering.
okText: The healer washed the wounds, applied herbal poultices and foretold quick recovery. Everyone felt better and one paid.

title: The haunted place
text: The camp was pitched in a place that according to legend is haunted. Part of the crew refuses to sleep.
okText: The healer performed a night ritual with candles and herbs and the ghosts apparently calmed. Everyone slept soundly.

title: The leader's challenge
text: The leader of another crew challenged your chief to a duel for control of the forest. Whoever loses must yield.
okText: The duellist stood in for the chief and beat the opponent in a flashy duel. The rival yielded and left a tribute.

title: A bet with a robber
text: A robber proposes a wager: a duel for a purse. If nobody accepts the challenge the crew is shamed.
okText: The duellist won the duel in seconds and the robber handed over his purse in thanks and proposed an alliance.

title: The night singer
text: From afar comes the singing of a man by a fire. The words are unknown but the melody melancholy.

title: The singer invites
text: The singer turned out to be a wandering bard who invites the crew to his fire. He tells of hidden trails and pays well for company.

title: The chest in the lake
text: The outline of a chest is visible at the bottom of a shallow lake. The water is black and the bank slippery.

title: What was in the chest
text: The chest was dragged out. Inside were old armours and rotten documents and at the bottom a gold coin with an unknown likeness.

title: The Kislevite fugitive
text: A Kislevite soldier who deserted his unit was found in the forest. He's wounded and terrified.

title: The Kislevite pursuit
text: A unit of Kislevite soldiers combs the forest searching for the deserter. The commander offers a reward for information.

title: The bear in a cage
text: A travelling circus-man lost a trained bear on a chain. The animal wanders the forest and people fear it.

title: The circus-man returns
text: The circus-man came back in tears begging help finding the bear. He promises a generous reward and tickets to the show.

title: The ravens on the road
text: Four ravens sit in a row on a branch and watch the crew. When someone approaches they fly off and return.

title: The ravens lead
text: The ravens led the crew to a wrecked wagon with a dead driver. Inside were a chest and a letter.

title: The hanging tree
text: Corpses of deserters hung from an old oak swaying in the wind. The camp was pitched far from there and nobody wanted to talk about it.

title: The burnt village
text: The crew came upon the ashes of a small village. Nobody survived and objects lay about the ground that might still be of use to someone.

title: Taal's fire
text: A forester invited the crew to a shared fire and taught how to identify animals by their tracks. Everyone learned something.

title: The feral dog
text: A feral dog with foam on its muzzle leapt from the bushes. One follower was bitten and everyone feared for his fate.

title: The strayed mare
text: A strayed mare with a beautiful coat ran into the camp. She wore a bridle with silver studs and her owner must be rich.

title: The ear of Taal
text: A stone figurine with a horn was found among the roots. The crew left it in place and felt something was watching them.

title: The tree with a nest
text: A flock of ravens nested in a giant tree. A few followers climbed up and found trinkets in the nest, including a few coins.

title: Fog and whispers
text: Whispers came from the fog as if several voices spoke at once. The crew stood motionless until dawn.

title: Stolen eggs
text: Ground-nesting birds had been robbed of their eggs. The crew felt guilty though nobody admitted it.

title: The felled oak
text: Lightning felled a giant oak that had been a landmark for hundreds of years. Trails in the area had to be laid out anew.

title: The wolf pack
text: A pack of wolves encircled the camp and waited as if they knew you'd move. The fire kept them at bay till morning.

title: An unwelcome guest
text: A strayed pilgrim sits by the fire loudly praying to Sigmar. The crew tries not to pay attention.

title: The lost sword
text: A beautiful sword with an engraved crest lay in the bushes. Nobody claimed it so it stayed with the crew.

title: The witch
text: A shrivelled witch in a remote hut served the crew soup and foretold everyone's doom. The soup tasted good.

title: The merchants' road
text: An old merchants' route crossed the forest and wagons still rolled along it. The crew took position in the bushes.

title: The cave
text: The crew found a small cave with a dry interior. They got comfortable though a strange wind blew from it.

title: Flood in the valley
text: The river burst its banks and flooded the valley, washing out old tombs. The crew gathered a few finds and left the area.

title: Children of the forest
text: A group of children from a nearby village went mushroom picking in the forest and got lost. The crew took them home.

title: The lantern in the tree
text: A lantern hung from a branch and its flame didn't die despite the wind. The crew gave it a wide berth.

title: The purse on a branch
text: A purse with a few coins hung from a branch as if left for a chance traveller. The crew thanked the unknown benefactor.

title: The storm
text: A storm swept through the forest with a roar breaking trees and flinging boughs. The crew sat under a shared tarpaulin and waited.

title: Will-o'-the-wisps
text: Wisps danced above the marsh. One follower wanted to follow them but the others stopped him.

title: The rotten tree
text: A rotten tree turned out a hollow full of honey. The crew shared with the bees.

title: The wounded stag
text: A wounded stag with an arrow in its flank ran deep into the forest. The crew tracked it and ended its suffering.

title: The friar's visit
text: A priest of Taal in a wolf pelt dropped in to the camp and asked for water. He told how to tell poisonous plants from edible ones.

title: Squirrels
text: Squirrels leapt along the branches and dropped nuts on the camp. Nobody complained about such jokes.

title: The petrified tree
text: An old tree was so hard it had become almost stone. The crew walked round it in awe.

title: The doe and fawns
text: A doe with two fawns grazed right beside the camp. Nobody scared her, though stomachs rumbled.

title: The ruined chapel
text: A ruined chapel of Sigmar with a cracked hammer on top stands in the forest. Someone left fresh flowers inside.

title: The cold
text: The night was so frosty the fire gave no warmth. By morning everyone was frozen and sleepless.

title: Drunken lumberjacks
text: A group of drunken woodcutters burst into camp looking for a fight. If nobody calms them there will be a brawl.
okText: The bodyguard stood before them with folded arms. The first woodcutter hesitated, the second walked away and the third paid "for admission".

title: The bear in a trap
text: A bear is stuck in a snare and rages in pain. If it breaks free there will be slaughter.
okText: The bodyguard freed the bear holding it by the scruff and led it back to the forest. The animal left its pelt, which could be sold.

title: The false merchant
text: A merchant in a cloak says he sells good wares, but the shadow noticed he's a thief seeking victims.
okText: The shadow exposed the false merchant, took his loot and gave it back to the victims for a token fee. The wronged rewarded the crew.

title: The robbers' captives
text: Robbers lead two captives through the forest. If someone frees them, gratitude will be generous.
okText: The shadow crept behind the robbers, cut the captives' bonds and led them out through the bushes. The rescued turned out to be wealthy merchants.

title: Poachers' snares
text: Someone set dozens of snares in the forest. Animals die and the count's men begin to take an interest.
okText: The marksman gathered the snares, laid them in a row and left them as a "gift" for the forester. In thanks he released a few hares for the crew.

title: The lost archer
text: A young archer whose unit went missing wanders the forest with an empty quiver. He asks for help.
okText: The marksman taught him a few tricks and gave him arrows. In thanks the youth shared a rumour of treasure nearby.

title: The robbers' council
text: Several robber bands met in a clearing for a council. If they quarrel the crew can profit.
okText: The provocateur sowed distrust among them and passed a few "secret" tips. The bands fell out and the crew gathered loot in peace.

title: The travelling theatre
text: A travelling troupe of actors stopped nearby and needs help with props. In return they promise a show.
okText: The provocateur took a role in the play and won applause. The troupe gave a purse and news in thanks.

title: The rusty lock
text: A rusty lock hangs on the door of a small hut. Perhaps something valuable is inside.
okText: The scavenger broke the lock noiselessly and found supplies and a few coins inside. He hung the lock back.

title: The lost luggage
text: Abandoned luggage from a journey lies on a forest road. Someone fled in panic.
okText: The scavenger gathered what was useful, sorted it and left the rest. Inside were supplies, a few coins and a good blanket.

title: The wagon in the mire
text: A wagon with goods sank into the mud. The driver begs for help and the goods look valuable.
okText: The carter led out the horses, pulled out the wagon and helped unload the goods. The owner paid generously and promised to recommend.

title: The missing guide
text: A merchants' guide went missing in the forest and a convoy lost its way. The merchants pay for help finding the road.
okText: The carter knew the forests like his own pocket and in a few hours led the convoy out. Payment came in silver and goods.

title: The robbers' lean-to
text: A robbers' lean-to stands in a clearing with a dozen robbers asleep inside. If they wake they will attack.
okText: The arsonist set the lean-to alight from outside cutting off the exits. The robbers fled in panic leaving everything behind.

title: The bridge over the river
text: A bridge over the river leads to the count's manor. If destroyed, the soldiers will be delayed and the crew gains time.
okText: The arsonist burned the bridge at night leaving no trace. The army's delay let the crew escape calmly and the grateful villagers paid.

title: The hidden trail
text: The scout spotted an invisible path but it's unknown where it leads. It could be a road to treasure or a trap.
okText: The scout followed it and reached an abandoned smugglers' camp with supplies and coins. The crew moved there for a night.

title: A flaw in the map
text: The crew reached a place not on the map. Ruins stand around and the forest looks unnatural.
okText: The scout investigated the ruins and found an old vault with a few coins. He warned the crew of traps and led them out safely.

title: Valuable pelts
text: A trader sells pelts for pennies but the goods smell of theft. Either a bargain or trouble.
okText: The fence examined the goods, recognised the guild marks and resold the pelts to their owner at a profit. Everyone was pleased.

title: The missing documents
text: A wanderer brought a parchment with official seals and wants to sell it. It turns out to be an arrest warrant.
okText: The fence forged a second document with a changed name and sold it to the right man. Both sides paid.

title: The sick girl
text: A girl in a nearby village has fevered for three days. The parents ask for help.
okText: The healer gave a willow bark decoction and herbs to bring down the fever. The girl recovered and the parents gave food and coins.

title: Fear of a curse
text: The crew found an amulet with a strange symbol and some followers panic. They speak of a curse.
okText: The healer performed a "cleansing" of the amulet with smoke and salt and then sold it to a curious merchant. The profit was decent and the panic passed.

title: A duel in the glade
text: Two knights challenge each other to a duel in a glade beside your camp. Someone may die.
okText: The duellist stepped in as mediator, proposed a duel without death and conducted it for fun. The knights paid for the service.

title: The nobleman's challenge
text: A nobleman with a retinue challenged the crew to a fight for the right to the path. Refusal means disgrace.
okText: The duellist accepted, beat the nobleman's best man and let him leave with honour. The nobleman left a ducat in thanks.

title: The strange belt
text: A belt with a buckle in the shape of a wolf's head lies on the ground. It seems new and expensive.

title: The belt's owner
text: An armed man arrives at the camp having lost his belt. He says it's a family heirloom and offers a reward for its return.

title: The blood trail
text: A fresh blood trail leads deep into the forest along the path. Someone wounded walked this way a few hours ago.

title: The wounded knight
text: Following the trail the crew found a wounded knight with a crest. He carries a purse and a letter to his lord. He begs help.

title: The little hut
text: A little hut with a smoking chimney stands in the forest. The host came out and invites you in.

title: The host asks
text: A few days later the hut's host comes with a request: wolves roam the forest and he needs defending. He promises payment.

title: The salt trader
text: A salt trader with a heavy wagon stopped near the camp and asks shelter for the night.

title: The wagon with treasure
text: The salt trader turned out to be a smuggler hiding a chest of valuables under the salt. In thanks for hiding him he gives the crew a share of the profit.

title: The crossroads
text: An old signpost with inscriptions in three languages stands at the crossroads. The crew argued long over which road to take.

title: Pine cones
text: The wind dropped pine cones on the camp with a clatter. Everyone leapt from their beds with weapons in hand.

title: Dew on cobwebs
text: In the morning dew covered every cobweb with diamonds. The crew was silent, enchanted by the sight.

title: The old shrine statue
text: A mossy statue of Shallya with a raised hand stood among the trees. The crew left a loaf of bread at its feet.

title: The lost traveller
text: A traveller from Nuln got lost in the forest and begged help. The crew showed him the way and kept his purse "for safekeeping".

title: Nuts
text: Hazelnuts ripened and lay on the ground like gold. The crew gathered a sack and slept with full stomachs.

title: The owl's hooting
text: A great owl perched above the camp and hooted a single note on repeat. Nobody could sleep.

title: The missing scout
text: The crew found someone's pack with a map and compass. The owner was nowhere to be seen and the map showed unknown trails.

title: The poacher
text: A poacher from a nearby village sold the crew a hare and two rabbits for a song. In the evening there was a feast.

title: The golden hour
text: The setting sun broke through the canopy and flooded the camp with golden light. Everyone felt the world can be beautiful.

title: A heavy night
text: The crew slept badly and in the morning everyone was tired and irritable. Even birdsong grated.

title: Strange torches
text: Torches flickered in the distance. Someone walked the forest at night and nobody knew who.

title: The fox den
text: Foxes settled in a den near the camp. The cubs played in the grass while the crew watched with smiles.

title: Trout
text: The crew built a dam of stones in the stream and caught a dozen fish. They fried them all night.

title: Red mushrooms
text: Red mushrooms with white spots sprouted on a glade. Everyone feared them and one scavenger put them in his bag.

title: The stone road
text: The crew stumbled upon a stone road built by the ancients. It ran straight as an arrow and vanished in the gloom.

title: The brook
text: A quiet brook below the camp murmured all night. Everyone slept like children.

title: The apparition
text: In the moonlight a white figure was seen standing motionless between the trees. The crew shut their eyes and prayed.

title: An avalanche of leaves
text: The wind piled a layer of leaves on the camp and everyone woke up in a mound as in a nest. It was warm.

title: The chamois
text: A chamois leapt onto a rock above the camp and looked down. Nobody knew whether it was a bad sign or good.

title: Spilled ale
text: A barrel of ale rolled from a wagon and burst. Nobody wept since most was saved in tankards.

title: Wild honey
text: Wild bees built a nest in an abandoned hut. The crew harvested the honey at the cost of a few stings.

title: Raven dust
text: By the fire someone told a legend of ravens that devour souls of the dead. Until morning nobody looked at the sky.

title: The deserters' camp
text: The crew found an abandoned deserters' camp with some supplies and holey tents. A good place to spend the night.

title: Young beavers
text: Beavers built a dam in the stream and the crew watched them work. Nobody wanted to disturb them.

title: Sun through the canopy
text: Sun rays broke through the treetops and the forest smelled of resin. Everyone walked lighter.

title: The lost child
text: A girl from a nearby village got lost in the forest and the crew found her. The parents gave honey and bread in thanks.

title: A stream full of gold
text: The sand in the stream glittered with golden flecks. A few followers panned it for half a day.

title: The stone circle
text: A ring of mossy stones stands among the trees. The crew didn't camp there though a warm wind blew from it.

title: The wild snake
text: A snake basked on a stone by the camp. One of the followers almost sat on it.

title: Hairy caterpillars
text: Caterpillars covered the tree trunk under which you slept. In the morning everyone had itching rashes.

title: The lost family
text: A peasant family seeking a new home stopped nearby. The crew shared food with them.

title: The abandoned lean-to
text: A charcoal burner's lean-to with a roof that still holds stands in the forest. The crew was glad of dry shelter.

title: Horsetail
text: Field horsetail grew round a spring. The scavenger knew it's a good herb for wounds and gathered a handful.

title: The ant march
text: A long column of ants crossed the camp to its anthill. Everyone lifted their feet as if a king were passing.

title: The treasure tale
text: By the fire an old bandit told a tale of treasure hidden in a hollow. For a few hours every tree was suspect.

title: The wounded otter
text: An otter with a broken paw fell into the camp. The crew dressed it and released it and it came back with a fish.

title: The tree on fire
text: An old tree took fire from lightning and burned like a torch. The crew gathered dry boughs for their own fire.

title: Smoke from the fire
text: Smoke from the fire betrayed the camp because the wind blew towards the valley. The crew quickly put out the flames and moved higher.

title: The turtles
text: Marsh turtles basked on logs by a pond. Village children collected them in sacks and the crew helped for a share of the haul.

title: Misty mornings
text: Mist didn't leave the forest till noon and every sound seemed to come from a different direction. The crew moved slowly.

title: The creaking door
text: In a remote hut a door creaked in the wind all night. Nobody dared close it.

title: The stump with a stone
text: A stone lodged in the trunk of an old tree as if thrown by a giant. The crew nodded and moved on.

title: The crack of a shot
text: Somewhere in the distance a crossbow or handgun fired. The crew listened but heard nothing more.

title: The merchants' camp
text: Merchants camped nearby and invited you to their fire. The crew joined and the conversation was pleasant and instructive.

title: The wayside bench
text: A wooden bench with a carved inscription stood by the path. The crew sat on it and rested.

title: The old fire ring
text: A ring of burned earth where nothing grew was found in a clearing. Everyone skirted it.

title: Frost on leaves
text: In the morning frost covered every leaf like silver. It turned cold but everyone felt strangely good.

title: The cone roof
text: The crew built a roof of branches that withstood even a downpour. Everyone was proud of themselves.

title: Rustling in the bushes
text: Something rustled in the bushes all night. The sentries expected the worst and in the morning found a hedgehog.

title: The woodcutters' track
text: A narrow woodcutters' track led through the forest towards a bright place. The crew followed it hesitantly.

title: The sunken boat
text: A sunken boat with a few objects inside lay in shallow water. The crew pulled them out and spread them to dry.

title: Fireflies
text: Thousands of fireflies floated over a clearing on a warm night. The crew sat in silence and watched.

title: The missing priest
text: A priest of Taal went missing in the forest and his pupils have been searching for a week. The crew pointed the direction where they saw tracks.

title: Moon dust
text: In the moonlight the clearing looked covered in silver. The crew pitched camp and spent one of the most peaceful nights.

title: The lost ranger
text: A stranger in a green cloak stumbled into the camp exhausted and hungry. He says he's a scout with a mercenary company.

title: The mercenary company
text: The mercenary company found their lost scout and thanks the crew with a generous gift. The captain asks for discretion.

title: The imprinted foot
text: On the clearing a strange footprint with six toes is visible. Villagers say it's a mutant.

title: The mutant shows himself
text: In the morning the mutant came out of the forest but proved a harmless old man. He flees from villagers and begs help. He says he has something to offer.

title: The barrel of pitch
text: A barrel of pitch stands in the forest as if left here. It smells fresh and is heavy.

title: What the pitch was for
text: It turned out the pitch belonged to a band of forgers working here. They came back for it armed and want to know who touched it.

title: The lone wolf
text: A lone lame wolf wandered to the camp and watches from afar. It neither flees nor attacks.

title: The wolf returns with a pack
text: The wolf returned with a whole pack and it turned out he leads them to an abandoned shed with supplies. The crew gained a new, strange friend.

title: The hunter's pouch
text: Under a bush lay a hunter's pouch with an empty flask and a few coins. The crew drank from the stream and kept the coins.

title: The green glade
text: The crew came upon a glade covered in soft grass and flowers. Camping there was like resting in a garden.

title: The animal trail
text: Wild animals blazed a trail through the forest to a watering hole. The crew followed it and avoided the road.

title: A bright morning
text: The sun rose cloudless and the birds began to sing. Everyone woke in good spirits.

title: A wet night
text: The rain didn't stop and the camp turned to mud. Nobody wanted to come out from under the tarpaulin.

title: The squirrel's hoard
text: The crew found a squirrel's hoard in a hollow: nuts, acorns and a few shiny coins. The squirrel watched reproachfully from a branch.

title: The travellers' fire
text: Wanderers lit a fire in the distance and the crew watched from the bushes as they feasted. After they left a few leftovers remained.

title: The hawk's shadow
text: A hawk circled above the camp hunting prey. Everyone kept close to the fire and the poultry vanished into the bushes.

title: The rusty trap
text: One follower stepped into an old rusty bear trap. He was pulled out unharmed but shocked.

title: A clump of rowan
text: Red rowan berries coloured the clearing. The crew hung sprigs over the entrance for luck.

title: Deafening thunder
text: A thunderstorm rolled over the forest. The whole camp shook but nothing happened.

title: The sunken trunk
text: A big trunk lying in the stream turned out full of fish. The crew caught a dozen without effort.

title: The dagger in the tree
text: A dagger with engraved initials was stuck in the trunk of an old tree. The crew pulled it out and after consideration kept it.

title: The shepherd's hut
text: A shepherd invited the crew to his hut and offered cheese and milk. The talk was short but warm.

title: A parachute of leaves
text: Leaves fell all night like rain. In the morning the camp was drowned in gold and red.

title: The stolen saddle
text: Someone left a saddle by a tree and walked off. The crew kept it "until claimed".

title: Green moss
text: The crew camped in a patch of green moss. They slept in soft bedding and in the morning smelled of the forest.

title: A stifling evening
text: The air was heavy and still. Everyone sweated and dreamed of rain.

title: The stone bridge
text: An old stone bridge linked the river banks. The crew crossed to the other side and saved time.

title: A sharp smell
text: The wind brought a smell of burning from afar. Everyone was worried but nothing happened.

title: Apple trees
text: Deep in the forest stood wild apple trees laden with fruit. The crew gathered them for two hours.

title: A debate about stars
text: By the fire two followers argued whether stars are the gods' fires or wisps. The rest fell asleep.

title: The old hunter
text: A grey hunter in a fox fur passed the camp and waved. He asked no questions.

title: The rotten log
text: A log someone sat on collapsed with a crash. Everyone laughed and the victim sulked for a long time.

title: A fox's visit
text: A fox crept into the camp and made off with a piece of bacon. Everyone saw it but nobody moved.

title: A strong wind
text: A strong wind blew all night and broke branches. Everyone slept under the tarpaulin holding on to each other.

title: The river
text: The crew reached a river that wasn't on the map. Crossing required ingenuity but succeeded.

title: Children's tracks
text: Small barefoot prints were visible in the soft ground. The crew couldn't tell if they were children or something else.

title: A stranger's meal
text: Someone left a basket of bread, cheese and onion under a tree. Nobody claimed it so the crew ate.

title: The obelisk
text: A leaning obelisk covered in runes stood among the trees. The crew didn't try to read them.

title: Talking crows
text: Two crows on a branch conversed as if they knew something you don't. The crew decided not to listen.

title: The fiddler in the forest
text: A fiddler played in the middle of the forest for nobody. The crew stood in silence and listened to the end.

title: Smoke and the smell of meat
text: From a distant glade came the smell of roasting meat. Everyone drooled and the crew went to see who was roasting.

title: The broken scythe
text: A broken scythe lay in the grass with traces of blood beside it. The crew skirted the spot.

title: Roe deer by the water
text: Roe deer grazed by the stream in the sunset light. The crew watched in silence.

title: Fragrant herbs
text: The scavenger found a field of wild herbs. He gathered a bunch of lavender, thyme and mint and the camp smelled like an apothecary.

title: The dying fire
text: The crew found a fire that still smouldered. Someone must have been here an hour ago but nobody was there.

title: The wooden cross
text: A lone wooden cross with an engraved name stands in the forest. The crew paused and whispered a prayer.

title: Cracking branch
text: A great branch cracked above the camp and fell right beside the tent. Nobody was hurt but everyone got up.

title: Three ravens
text: Three ravens sat on a branch and watched the crew. Nobody knew if they foretold doom or favoured.

title: Wolfberries
text: The crew found a bush of wolfberries and remembered someone once poisoned himself with them. Everyone kept their hands to themselves.

title: The riderless horse
text: A horse with an empty saddle came out of the forest and stood still by the camp. The crew kept it.

title: Mud on the road
text: The road turned into a muddy stream. Every step took effort and wagons sank to the axles.

title: The eagle's nest
text: On top of a rock eagles built a nest. The crew watched them feed their young and withdrew respectfully.

title: Shooting stars
text: Under a starry sky dozens of stars fell. Everyone made a wish and some wept.

title: The friendly squirrel
text: A tame squirrel came to the camp and ate from a hand. Everyone rejoiced like children.

title: The climbing plant
text: A strange plant twined round tree trunks, blooming purple. The scavenger knew it was poison and told everyone not to touch it.

title: The priestess's visit
text: A priestess of Rhya with a basket of fruit stopped at the camp, blessed everyone and left. The crew felt better.

title: The forest closes in
text: The trees seemed thicker than the day before as if the forest closed behind the crew. Nobody commented but everyone sped up.

title: The bear's hoard
text: A bear's den proved empty and trinkets from past victims lay inside. The crew took some and left quietly.

title: The odd tree
text: The crew came upon a tree that grew as if someone bent it. Everyone spoke of magic and one person of art.

title: Clear water
text: A spring in the rock gushed water so pure the crew filled all the skins and washed their faces. The morning was fresh.

title: Lush ferns
text: Ferns reached waist height and in their shade it was cool and damp. The crew rested in silence.

title: The wolves' ravine
text: Wolves made a den in the ravine. The crew gave it a wide berth but heard their breathing all night.

title: Carrion
text: The crew came upon a stag carcass. Ravens feasted and the air was foul and heavy. The followers hurried on.

title: The burnt-out trunk
text: A huge trunk burned hollow served as a shelter. The crew settled in it like a real home.

title: Tree shadows
text: The moon cast long shadows over the glade that moved when nobody was looking. The sentries changed every hour.
